pages.text: Plays a note at the trigger block like a note block.$(br2)$(1)note$() is 0 to 24, like the clicks on a note block. Instruments are note block instruments such as harp, bass, bell or flute. A wrong note or instrument raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)note$() INTEGER: the note, 0 to 24$(li)$(1)instrument$() STRING: the instrument (optional, default "harp")
